signals.text: 1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Dig past the first request to the real decision a pricing, underwriting, actuarial, or claims team is trying to make, asking why enough times to get there
Enable the data products behind those decisions, from the datasets that feed a rate review to the views a claims team works from
Connect data across the systems that hold it, including Snapsheet and Xactimate for claims and vendor loss modeling from RMS and Verisk, so a change in any of them is understood…
Build supporting datasets proactively, ahead of the questions, so teams can dig into a metric or a problem without waiting on a new pull
Scope and deliver data products in partnership with data engineering
